correctness.rationale: Factorization D(I-tS)^-1 proves compactness; triangular recursion and left/right binomial eigenvectors give algebraic multiplicity one and rank-one Riesz projections. Exact dual norm yields the formula. Gaussian local limit for negative binomial and binomial norms produces the exact p-dependent coefficient. Analytic generating functions prove totality, and divergent singleton projection norms exclude any Schauder ordering. 180 exact finite-section test configurations passed; they do not replace infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural stability of spectral decompositions for positive compact Cesàro operators is answered quantitatively: exact all-p projection norms and a sharp exponential/Gaussian growth rate explain how a complete simple eigensystem can fail to be a Schauder basis. The boundary t=0 is exact and mathematically natural, not an arbitrary finite slice.
